prompt_template: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided warehouse photograph. Asset: realistic misplaced-stock test counterpart, one photograph only. {change} Preserve the exact original image framing, resolution/aspect ratio, camera angle, warehouse structure, lighting, floor, green pallets and every unaffected product. Move carton contents naturally with matched local perspective and shrink-wrap reflections. Do not move the shelf labels with the products. Preserve every location label letter and digit verbatim. No annotations, no arrows, no colored outlines, no new text, no collage. Output only the single edited photo.
